tier1.text: Each brachiocephalic vein drains blood from the upper chest. This vein begins where the subclavian vein from the armpit meets the jugular veins from the head and neck. Veins draining the front of the chest wall also flow into each brachiocephalic vein. The right and left brachiocephalic veins join to form the superior vena cava, which returns blood to the heart.

quotes.quote: Brachiocephalic veins | Pair of veins that form from a fusion of the external and internal jugular veins and the subclavian vein; subclavian, external and internal jugulars, vertebral, and internal thoracic veins flow into it; drain the upper thoracic region and lead to the superior vena cava
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: This vein begins where the subclavian vein from the armpit meets the jugular veins from the head and neck.

quotes.quote: On both the left and right sides, the subclavian vein forms when the axillary vein passes through the body wall from the axillary region. It fuses with the external and internal jugular veins from the head and neck to form the brachiocephalic vein.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Veins draining the front of the chest wall also flow into each brachiocephalic vein.

quotes.quote: Each internal thoracic vein, also known as an internal mammary vein, drains the anterior surface of the chest wall and flows into the brachiocephalic vein.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: Trunk of systemic vein which is formed by the union of the right and left brachiocephalic veins and terminates in the right atrium.
